meetdock.welcome.contents:
No meetings registered.

🏢 Enterprise Teams
Drag & Drop .ics file: Drag and drop an .ics calendar file downloaded from Teams or Outlook directly onto this pane to register automatically.
Add from Clipboard: Copy meeting invitation text and click [Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard) (Alt+M / Option+M).

$(warning) Note for Enterprise Teams: Some .ics files saved from email attachments or certain notification emails may contain only an individual occurrence (RECURRENCE-ID) and no recurrence rule (RRULE). In that case, the meeting is registered as a one-time meeting. You can configure recurrence after registering the meeting.

👤 Personal Teams
Add from Clipboard / Text: Copy the meeting join link or invitation text and click [Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard) (Alt+M / Option+M) or drag & drop text into this pane.
Configure Settings: Select the title, date/time, and recurrence pattern in the dialog to register.

[Add Meeting from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard)
